initiatives.coordinateBasis: Emirate-level strategy marker — not a surveyed project-site coordinate

initiatives.timing: Announced Apr 2024 with a ten-year first-phase delivery horizon

initiatives.supplyRiskNote: Ultimate-capacity figures must not be treated as current throughput; ten-year first-phase horizon.

initiatives.supplyRiskNote: Watch station-area launch cadence; corridor-level claims overstate impact versus station catchments.

initiatives.name: Dubai Metro Gold Line

initiatives.supplyRiskNote: Not yet construction-stage; property narrative risk if timelines slip from 2026 tender / 2027 award / 2032 opening path.
initiatives.researchNotes: Fixed stale summary that still said 34.2 km. Official RTA press release (22 Apr 2026) confirms 42 km / 18 stations / AED34bn / open 9 Sep 2032.
